name: elder_impulse_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: Dr. Alexander Elder's Impulse System combines two indicators — EMA(13) for trend and MACD histogram for momentum — to color-code each bar as green (trend+momentum aligned bullish), red (aligned bearish), or blue (conflicting). The system's strict rule: NEVER short green bars, NEVER go long on red bars. On 1-min Indian intraday charts with adapted parameters (EMA(9) and MACD(9,21,7) for faster response), the Impulse System identifies periods of aligned momentum that last 5-15 bars, followed by transitions. The inefficiency exists because: (1) Elder's system is designed as a FILTER, not a signal — most implementations miss this and trade the color change directly, (2) the dual-indicator alignment (trend + momentum) provides higher-quality signals than either alone, (3) the 'forbidden trade' rule (no shorts in green, no longs in red) is psychologically difficult for traders who want to fade the move, creating persistent edge for followers.
mechanism: Institutional order flow arrives in bursts via algorithmic execution (TWAP/VWAP slicing), creating persistent directional pressure over 30-120 seconds. Retail and smaller participants follow the initial move, extending momentum before liquidity absorbs the flow and the order book rebalances.

indicators.name: impulse_color
indicators.formula: 'green' if EMA_9 > EMA_9[1] AND MACD_histogram > MACD_histogram[1]; 'red' if EMA_9 < EMA_9[1] AND MACD_histogram < MACD_histogram[1]; 'blue' otherwise

conditions: impulse_color changes from 'red' or 'blue' to 'green' (momentum alignment bullish)
impulse_color changes from 'green' or 'blue' to 'red' (momentum alignment bearish)

exit.signal_exit: impulse_color changes to opposite color (full reversal confirmed)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 12 and 22 (need trends for color alignment to persist)
filters.volume_filter: volume on color change bar > SMA(volume, 10)

weaknesses: The dual-indicator system generates many 'blue' (neutral) bars — approximately 40-50% of the session. During these periods, no trades are taken, reducing opportunities.
On range-bound days, the impulse color alternates rapidly between green, blue, and red, generating whipsaw losses. The 5-change-per-30-bar filter helps but doesn't fully prevent this.
The MACD histogram on 1-min bars is very noisy and can flip positive/negative on minor price fluctuations, creating false color changes.
prior_art: Elder (1993) 'Trading for a Living' — original Impulse System. Elder (2002) 'Come Into My Trading Room' — refined version. Elder (2014) 'The New Trading for a Living' — updated parameters. In India, Elder's system is taught in advanced TA courses and available as an indicator on TradingView.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
